_about: Polish1 D4e (item 38): the Re-forge sleeps until three maritime pieces are powered, in any order, each needing the island power on. lighthouse: find its brass lens (it lies at one of `lens_spots`, picked per run; anyone who touches it carries it for the party), then fit it at the door. foghorn: hold interact for `hold_seconds` to crank it. tide_wheel: interact to set it turning, then the party kills `kills` enemies within `radius` metres of it in `seconds`, else it stops and can be set turning again. `hill_top`: it crowns a hill on purpose (the layout check allows it). `solid`: its body's half size (reach counts from there). `face`: the model's front looks at the island's centre (in), away from it (out), or at a yaw in degrees. Spots are metres from the island's centre.

lines.cold: The Re-forge is cold. Wake it: light %s.
lines.lens_found: A brass lamp lens. It belongs in a lighthouse.
lines.lens_needed: %s: its lamp has no lens. One lies somewhere on the islands.
lines.ritual: %s turns: %d of %d kills near it, %d s
lines.ritual_failed: %s has stopped. Set it turning again.
